adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff around line 1079 (in the actual diff context around lines 1060-1070), the code sets `destinationCalendar` to either `[eventType.destinationCalendar]`, `[organizerUser.destinationCalendar]`, or `null`. Then at line 1079 (shown in diff), there's `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If neither eventType nor organizerUser has a destinationCalendar, `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, and the optional chaining `?.push()` will silently do nothing - the teamDestinationCalendars collected for COLLECTIVE scheduling will be discarded. The fix should initialize to an empty array `[]` instead of `null` when no organizer calendar exists, so team calendars can still be added.
